To calculate the difference in heat generation and onset temperature, we need to compare the values for the bare material and the ZrO2 loading with the least heat.

From Table 3, we can see that the bare material has a heat generation of 666.42 J/g and an onset temperature of 231.93°C.

The ZrO2 loading with the least heat (1.0 wt.% ZrO2) has a heat generation of 487.31 J/g and an onset temperature of 237.59°C.

To calculate the difference in heat generation, we subtract the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading from the heat generation of the bare material:

Difference in heat generation = 666.42 J/g - 487.31 J/g = 179.11 J/g

To calculate the difference in onset temperature, we subtract the onset temperature of the bare material from the onset temperature of the ZrO2 loading:

Difference in onset temperature = 237.59°C - 231.93°C = 5.66°C
